title: Introduction to AI and LLMs: Lira Launch Day
summary: Meet the team, set up your free AI course account and try your first AI tools, two days before the January cohort starts.
imageAlt: Learners setting up the AI course on their phones

description.text: The free Introduction to AI and LLMs course starts on Monday, 11 January 2027. This launch day helps you start ready: we set up your course account with you, show you how to save data while learning, and try a few AI tools together.
Bring a charged smartphone or laptop. Wi-Fi is provided for the morning. Seats are limited, so get a free ticket to hold your place.

items: Set up your Cyberiad Labs course account
Install the small offline AI model that comes with the course
Learn how to check what AI tells you
Meet other learners in your cohort

agenda.title: What AI is, and where it fails
Account setup, with helpers on hand
Try it: your first useful prompts

title: GetDigital Awards 2026: Gala Night
summary: An evening to celebrate this year's nominees and announce the winners of the GetDigital Awards 2026.
imageAlt: Guests at an evening awards ceremony

description.text: Join the nominees, partners and supporters of GetDigital for dinner, music and the announcement of the GetDigital Awards 2026 winners in all five categories.
Voting closes on 12 December 2026. Results are announced live on the night and published on our website the same evening.

items: Dinner and soft drinks included with every ticket
Live music and a short film on this year's nominees
Winners announced in all five categories

title: Small Business Digital Clinic
summary: A hands on morning for small business owners: Google Maps listing, WhatsApp Business, mobile money records and simple AI tools.
imageAlt: A shop owner updating a business listing on a phone

description.text: Bring your phone and your business questions. In one morning you leave with your shop on Google Maps, a WhatsApp Business catalogue and a simple way to track sales.
Small groups of eight, each with a trainer.

agenda.title: AI for product descriptions and replies

title: Online Safety for Parents
summary: A free evening talk on keeping children safe online.

description.text: Parents learned how to set up phones for children, what apps to watch and how to talk about online safety at home.
